title: A Parameterized Algorithm for Testing whether the Limit of a Diagram is Empty
summary: A limit of a (small) diagram $d : J \to E$ in a complete category $E$ can be thought of as specifying a set of equations involving the objects of $E$. To motivate this intuitively, one can think of each object $d(j)$ as a "variable" and each morphism in $J$ as a "constraint" connecting these variables. If $E$ has an initial object, a natural question arises: does our set of equations have any solution at all? Equivalently, we can ask: is the limit of $d$ initial?
